result.title: DrawOffer: Evidence-Grounded Longitudinal User-State Modeling for Career Support
result.comment: 9 pages, 4 tables. Evaluation code and aggregate results: https://github.com/ql-link/DrawOffer-Eval . Core engine private; not all experiments independently reproducible
result.summary: Career-support assistants must distinguish user claims from evidence of current ability and withhold judgments when evidence is insufficient. DrawOffer separates language-model observation extraction from deterministic inference over source-linked records to maintain uncertain ability estimates, experience assessments, and revisable issues. We evaluate 102 fictional personas with 580 scored checkpoints, a historical full-context and Mem0 comparison, and three auxiliary knowledge-tracing datasets. On 37 test personas, DrawOffer passes 169/210 checkpoints; checkpoint-defined issue precision and recall are 0.875 and 0.636. Across three development simulations, 87.0% of checkpoint verdicts agree, including persistent failures. A cache-only development ablation replacing answer-evidence requirements with confidence-only settlement reduces majority-vote passes from 306 to 293 of 370 and issue precision from 0.927 to 0.725. Equalizing positive source weights improves predictive metrics without changing total passes; removing decay gives mixed results. These findings support an exploratory systems contribution centered on evidence sufficiency. Developer-authored scenarios, unmatched baseline models, historical test exposure, and incomplete public artifacts limit generalization and independent reproduction.

AI.brief_summary: DrawOffer 把语言模型负责的观察抽取与基于可溯源记录的确定性推断分离，以维护带不确定性的用户能力估计和可修订问题判断，并在 102 个虚构人物、Mem0 基线与辅助知识追踪数据集上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据不足则不作判断」的信念状态维护与证据充分性结算，可能为 LVR 中何时停止推理、拒答及筛选视觉证据提供问题表述和评价线索，是否可迁移到多模态仍需核查。
